data.one_liner: A Dart package for countdown, countup, and infinite countup streams.
data.what_it_does: Provides a StreamDuration class to easily manage time durations as streams. It supports countdowns, countups from an initial duration, and infinite countups.
use_when: You need to display a countdown timer in your app.
You need to track elapsed time with a countup timer stream.
avoid_when: You are looking for a complete audio/video streaming solution.
strengths: Supports countdown, countup, and countup infinity out of the box.
Provides play, pause, resume, and duration adjustment controls.
weaknesses: Limited documentation outside of basic README examples.
